name: MetaVolume Data Loader and Time-Step Cache
definition: A data loading and caching system for volumetric datasets composed of multiple sub-volumes with time steps. It parses a configuration file, reads raw binary volume data, handles data type conversion and endian swapping, and caches previous time steps to avoid re-reading from disk.
summary: The MetaVolume Data Loader and Time-Step Cache manages multi-subvolume volumetric datasets by caching previous time steps to avoid repeated disk reads.
